about: Who speaks with which voice in a podcast episode (docs/PODCASTS.md, 'The voices'). The show's own people (the hosts and the Greek guest) keep one voice in every episode; a story character gets a voice from the pool of their gender, chosen from their name, so the same character sounds the same everywhere and no two people of one episode share a voice. A script's cast member may name a voice for one family (cast[].voice). Google's 30 voices carry the same name and sound in Gemini TTS and in Cloud Text-to-Speech (Chirp 3 HD), in every language, so a host can also say Greek in her own voice. The word after each voice is Google's own description of it.
